ingredients.item: Pork spare ribs, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Start the rice first. Rinse the rice and cook it by the directions on the package.
Pat the ribs dry. Toss them with the salt and the pepper and leave them on the counter.
In a small bowl, stir together the ketchup, sugar, tamari, 1 tsp lime juice, the cornstarch and 1/3 cup water. Set it aside.
Meanwhile, thinly slice the shallot and the garlic. Cut the bell peppers into 1-inch squares, slice the mushrooms, and slice the green onions.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large lidded skillet over medium-high until it shimmers. Add the ribs in a single layer, working in two batches if they crowd. Leave them alone for 2 minutes until the underside is deep brown, then turn them and brown the other sides for 2 minutes. Transfer them to a plate.
Turn the heat down to medium. Add the shallot to the same pan and cook for 1 minute, scraping up the browned bits. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until it smells fragrant.

Return the ribs and any juices to the pan and add 2/3 cup water. Cover and cook over medium-low for 25 minutes, until a chopstick slips easily into the meat. Check once halfway and add a splash of water if the pan is dry.
Add the bell peppers and cook uncovered for 2 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook for 1 minute, until they soften.
Stir the sauce again, since the cornstarch settles, and pour it into the pan. Toss for about 1 minute, until it thickens and coats the ribs.
Take the pan off the heat. Squeeze the rest of the lime over the ribs and scatter the green onions over the top.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
method_notes: Vicky Pham leads: pork spare ribs cut small, browned, braised in a little water until tender, then finished with bell peppers, mushrooms and a ketchup-based sauce thickened with cornstarch. Delightful Plate and Runaway Rice build the sauce differently (vinegar, honey and tomato; or pineapple-orange juice and tomato paste) and cook the ribs longer. Maggi seasoning and oyster sauce were swapped for gluten-free tamari to keep this gluten-free, and the optional parboil was dropped to hold the time. Ask the butcher to cut the ribs into 1-inch pieces. At 50 minutes this sits right on the line for the 45-minute area.
